description: Construction of a single storey outbuilding within rear garden, a single storey wraparound rear extension, a dormer roof extension to main rear roof, roof extension above two storey outrigger and replacement front bay window at ground floor level together with the installation of three roof lights to front roof slope, replacement front door at ground floor level and replacement rear and front windows at first floor level.
decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed entirely of the materials details shown on plan Nos.</p><p>&nbsp; unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the residential dwelling at 30 Edinburgh Road and for no other purpose. The outbuilding shall not be open for use by the occupier's staff or visiting clients, and it shall not be used for any form of living or sleeping accommodation.
